contract.actionReadback: Input-triggered only; may contain zero actions. No idle/move/wheel control-state polling. Enabled source auto-run opts in to change events.
contract.frameSubmission: One owning queue submission per admitted frame with child included. Asset setup/snapshots can submit separately.
contract.dynamicLimits: Bounded preallocated state, one DataGrid per surface and one non-nested embedded presenter; no arbitrary GPU heap growth or structural patch migration.
